purpose: Independent research prototype on public de-identified data; not clinical validation, not publication-ready
question: In TCGA-BRCA patients with all three modalities, does a frozen-transformer embedding of the diagnostic pathology report add held-out progression-free-interval ranking information beyond baseline clinical covariates, and beyond clinical + RNA-seq?
endpoint_source: TCGA-CDR (Liu et al., Cell 2018), columns PFI/PFI.time and OS/OS.time, times in days

nn.architecture: late fusion: per-modality branch Linear(d,16)-ReLU-Dropout(0.2)-Linear(16,8)-ReLU; concatenate branches; Linear(8*m,1,bias=False)
nn.loss: Breslow negative Cox partial log-likelihood (full batch)
nn.seed_aggregation: C-index averaged over seeds (pairwise scores averaged); no ensembling of risks; no best-seed selection

primary_metric: Strict-time Harrell C-index (pairs with strictly ordered observed times and an event at the earlier time; tied risks get half credit)
secondary_metric: Uno's IPCW C-index (scikit-survival concordance_index_ipcw), censoring distribution from development set, tau = 1826 days

bootstrap.interval: 95% percentile; paired (same resamples for all models)

decision_rule: Text is reported as adding detectable held-out information only if, for the primary Cox family on PFI, the paired bootstrap 95% CI of C(clinical_text) - C(clinical) excludes 0 on the positive side. C(clinical_rna_text) - C(clinical_rna) is the key secondary contrast under the same rule. Otherwise report: no detectable gain in this cohort. Point estimates alone are not evidence.
sensitivity: Test-set evaluation of already-fitted models after removing patients whose report matches prespecified text flags (src/text.py SENSITIVITY_FLAGS). No refitting.
dev_only_diagnostics: text PCs -> tissue source site (TSS) predictability, text only, no outcomes
site-only Cox (TSS one-hot) development CV C-index to bound how much a site signal alone could rank outcomes
